experiences.name: Hanoi Old Quarter Street Food Tour
experiences.description: Wander through the maze-like streets of Hanoi's Old Quarter sampling iconic Vietnamese dishes including Bun Cha, Banh Mi, Pho, and Egg Coffee from local vendors and hole-in-the-wall eateries. Join a budget walking food tour or explore independently using a street food map.

experiences.name: Hoi An Ancient Town Lantern Festival & Night Market
experiences.description: Explore the UNESCO-listed Ancient Town of Hoi An, browse the vibrant night market, release a lantern on the Thu Bon River, and feast on local specialties like Cao Lau and White Rose Dumplings from street stalls. The town glows with hundreds of silk lanterns every evening.

experiences.name: Motorbiking the Hai Van Pass
experiences.description: Rent a motorbike or join a budget group tour to ride the legendary Hai Van Pass, one of Southeast Asia's most scenic coastal mountain roads. The route offers breathtaking views of the South China Sea, lush jungle, and connects Da Nang to Hue — a quintessential backpacker adventure.
experiences.location: Hai Van Pass, between Da Nang and Hue

experiences.name: Mekong Delta Boat & Village Tour
experiences.description: Take a budget day trip from Ho Chi Minh City into the Mekong Delta, navigating narrow canals by sampan boat, visiting floating markets, coconut candy workshops, and local villages. Sample fresh tropical fruits and regional dishes like Banh Xeo (sizzling crepes) prepared by local families.

experiences.name: Bui Vien Walking Street Night Experience
experiences.description: Dive into the heart of Ho Chi Minh City's backpacker scene on Bui Vien Street. Enjoy cheap Bia Hoi (fresh draft beer), grilled street skewers, Banh Trang Tron (rice paper salad), and soak up the electric atmosphere of live music, neon lights, and fellow travelers from around the world.
experiences.location: Bui Vien Street, Pham Ngu Lao Backpacker District, Ho Chi Minh City
